description: Simple programming tasks that require multiple steps

tasks.name: fibonacci_sequence
tasks.prompt: Create a function to calculate the nth Fibonacci number, test it with n=10, and then optimize it using memoization. Print 'FIBONACCI TEST PASSED' when both functions work correctly and show the optimization benefit.
tasks.description: Start with basic recursive function, test it, then improve with memoization

tasks.name: data_analysis_pipeline
tasks.prompt: Create a list of 100 random numbers, calculate basic statistics (mean, median, std), and create a histogram visualization. Print 'VISUALIZATION COMPLETE' when the histogram is successfully created.

tasks.name: file_processing
tasks.prompt: Create a CSV file with sample data (name, age, city), read it back, and filter for people over 25. Print 'FILTERING COMPLETE' when you've successfully filtered and displayed the results.
tasks.description: Write CSV -> read CSV -> process data

tasks.name: web_data_fetch
tasks.prompt: Make a simple HTTP request to get JSON data, parse it to extract specific fields, and save results to a file. Print 'DATA SAVED' when file is successfully written.
